NeRF 볼륨은 표면 밀도만 학습되어 내부 밀도가 정확하지 않습니다. 밀: NeRF learns primarily surface density, so internal density is inaccurate. Deriving stiffness from mean density made the object overly wobbly; we compared user-defined stiffness values instead. In the 64³ deformable model, values below 1.0 caused excessive internal motion, so stiffness was fixed at 1.0.
PBD 외에도 축이나 중심점을 기준으로 한 수식 변형을 같은 파이프라인에: In addition to PBD, formula-based deformations around axes or a center were integrated into the same pipeline. Wave periodically displaces along y using z and time; Twist rotates around z based on distance and time; Bubble expands and contracts radially around a center.
새 시점 영상을 학습 루프 없이 바로 변형하기 때문에 화질이 떨어지는 한: Directly deforming novel-view images without a training loop limits image quality, in exchange for real-time deformation and fast computation.
지금은 타원체 마스크와 고정 임계값으로 노이즈를 지웁니다. 데이터마다 자: Noise is currently removed using an ellipsoid mask and fixed threshold. Automatically removing noise for each dataset is a future task.
NeRF는 내부 밀도가 부정확해 강성을 사람이 정했습니다. 볼륨 특성에서: NeRF's inaccurate internal density required manually selected stiffness. Automatically determining stiffness from volume characteristics is a potential research direction.
